notifications.label.description: The name of the feed of the reader's notifications, for assistive technology.

notifications.filters.description: What the tabs over the notifications choose between (all of them, or the mentions), for assistive technology.

notifications.all.description: The tab that shows every notification.

notifications.mentions.description: The tab that shows only the notifications that speak to the reader: mentions and quotes.

notifications.requests_hint.defaultMessage: From accounts your notification settings hold back
notifications.requests_hint.description: The hint under the row of the notification requests.

notifications.unread.description: The mark of an unread notification, for assistive technology.

notifications.read_all.description: The button over the notifications that marks every notification read.

notifications.accept.description: The button of a follow request notification that lets the account follow the reader.

notifications.reject.description: The button of a follow request notification that refuses to let the account follow the reader.

notifications.approve.description: The button of a notification asking to reply to, boost or quote the reader's post that approves it.

notifications.decline.description: The button of a notification asking to reply to, boost or quote the reader's post that refuses it.

notifications.follow_back.description: The button of a follow notification that follows the account back.

notifications.follow.description: The button of a notification that follows its account (the account a followed account moved to).

notifications.following.description: What a notification says, in place of its follow button, of an account the reader follows.

notifications.requested.description: What a notification says, in place of its follow button, of an account whose approval the reader's follow request awaits.

notifications.accepted.description: What a request notification says once the reader accepted or approved it.

notifications.rejected.description: What a request notification says once the reader rejected or declined it.

notifications.loading.description: What the notifications say while the first of them load.

notifications.loading_more.description: What the notifications say under them while more load.

notifications.failed.defaultMessage: The notifications could not be loaded.
notifications.failed.description: What the notifications say when the first of them could not be loaded, beside a button to try again.

notifications.retry.description: The button after the notifications in the column beside the timeline that could not be loaded; it loads them again.

notifications.failed_more.defaultMessage: More notifications could not be loaded.
notifications.failed_more.description: What the notifications say under them when more could not be loaded, beside a button to try again.

notifications.empty.description: What the notifications say when the reader has none.

notifications.untitled_event.description: The name of an event without a title, in the sentence of a notification about it.

notifications.kind.account_moved.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications: {name} is the display name, or the @handle, of an account that the user followed, which moved to another account. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.admin_account_moved.defaultMessage: An account that the moderators of {instance} limit moved to another account
notifications.kind.admin_account_moved.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications, to a moderator: an account that the moderators limit moved to another account, which does not get the limit. It never names the accounts. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.admin_appeal.defaultMessage: A new appeal awaits the moderators of {instance}
notifications.kind.admin_appeal.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications, to a moderator: a user appealed a moderation action. It never names the user. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.admin_custom_emoji_re.defaultMessage: A custom emoji request awaits review on {instance}
notifications.kind.admin_custom_emoji_re.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications, to an administrator: a user requested a custom emoji or a new image of one. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.admin_report.defaultMessage: A new report awaits the moderators of {instance}
notifications.kind.admin_report.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications, to a moderator: someone reported an account that had no open report. It never names the accounts. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.admin_sign_up.defaultMessage: A new sign-up awaits approval on {instance}
notifications.kind.admin_sign_up.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications, to a moderator: a new user signed up and waits for approval. It never names the user. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.admin_webhook_disable.defaultMessage: A webhook of {instance} was turned off
notifications.kind.admin_webhook_disable.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications, to an administrator: the server turned off a webhook endpoint that kept failing or answered that it is gone. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.announcement.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications: {title} is the announcement's title, as the administrators wrote it. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.auto_delete_limit.defaultMessage: {instance}: posts older than {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} will be deleted automatically {daysLeft, plural, =0 {from now on} one {in # day} other {in # days}}
notifications.kind.auto_delete_limit.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications: {days} is the most days after its publication that a post is kept; {daysLeft} is the days of the grace period until the maximum applies (0 when it applies at once). {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.scheduled_status_fail.defaultMessage: {instance}: your scheduled post could not be published {reason, select, restricted {because your account cannot post now} reply_unavailable {because the post it replies to is no longer available} quote_unavailable {because the post it quotes is no longer available} media_unavailable {because an attached file is no longer available} invalid {because it does not meet the requirements for a post} rejected {because the server's automated review refused it} other {}}
notifications.kind.scheduled_status_fail.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications: {reason} says why: restricted (the account may not post now), reply_unavailable (the post it replies to is gone or does not take the reply), quote_unavailable (the post it quotes is gone or may not be quoted), media_unavailable (an attached file is gone or failed processing), invalid (the post does not pass the checks, such as its length), rejected (the server's automated review refused it). {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.appeal_decided.defaultMessage: The moderators of {instance} decided your appeal
notifications.kind.appeal_decided.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications: the moderators upheld or overturned the user's appeal. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.custom_emoji_request_.defaultMessage: The administrators of {instance} reviewed your custom emoji request
notifications.kind.custom_emoji_request_.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications: an administrator approved or rejected the user's request for a custom emoji or a new image of one. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.boost.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications: {name} is the display name, or the @handle, of the account that boosted the user's post. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.favourite.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications: {name} is the display name, or the @handle, of the account that favourited the user's post. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.follow.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications: {name} is the display name, or the @handle, of the account that followed the user. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.follow_accepted.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications: {name} is the display name, or the @handle, of the account that accepted the user's follow request. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.follow_request.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications: {name} is the display name, or the @handle, of the account that asked to follow the user. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.mention.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications: {name} is the display name, or the @handle, of the account that wrote a post that mentions the user. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.moderation_notice.defaultMessage: The moderators of {instance} sent you a notice
notifications.kind.moderation_notice.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications: a notice to the user from the moderators. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.other.defaultMessage: You have a new notification on {instance}
notifications.kind.other.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications: {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.poll_closed.defaultMessage: A poll you took part in has ended
notifications.kind.poll_closed.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications: a poll that the user created or voted in has ended. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.quote.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications: {name} is the display name, or the @handle, of the account that quoted the user's post in a post of its own. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.reaction.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications: {name} is the display name, or the @handle, of the account that reacted to the user's post with an emoji. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.relationships_severed.defaultMessage: {instance} ended some of your follows with accounts on other servers
notifications.kind.relationships_severed.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications: follows between the user and accounts of other servers ended, because the moderators suspended a server or an account, or because this server stopped federating with a server (it federates only with the servers it allows). {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.report_resolved.defaultMessage: A report you filed on {instance} has been resolved
notifications.kind.report_resolved.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications: the moderators resolved a report that the user filed. It never says how. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.status.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications: {name} is the display name, or the @handle, of an account that the user subscribes to, which made a new post. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.supporter_payment_fai.defaultMessage: A payment for your supporter plan on {instance} failed
notifications.kind.supporter_payment_fai.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications: a payment for the user's supporter plan failed. It never says where to pay (the app shows no way to pay). {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.supporter_plan_retire.defaultMessage: Your supporter plan on {instance} was retired
notifications.kind.supporter_plan_retire.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications: the administrators retired the user's supporter plan, whose subscription ends with its period. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.supporter_subscriptio.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications: the user's supporter subscription ended (a payment kept failing, a refund, a retired plan, or a cancellation). {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.service_closure_annou.defaultMessage: {instance} will close: export your data before it does
notifications.kind.service_closure_annou.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications, to every user: the administrators announced that the server closes on a date. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.service_closure_resch.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications, to every user: the administrators changed the dates of the announced closure of the server. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.service_closure_withd.defaultMessage: {instance} will not close: the closure was withdrawn
notifications.kind.service_closure_withd.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications, to every user: the administrators withdrew the announced closure of the server, which goes on. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.admin_service_closure.defaultMessage: The closing date of {instance} has passed: close the server
notifications.kind.admin_service_closure.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications, to an administrator who may close the server: the closing date of the announced closure has passed, and the server closes only when an administrator closes it. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.admin_error_group_cre.defaultMessage: A new error was reported on {instance}
notifications.kind.admin_error_group_cre.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications, to an administrator who manages the errors: the server or the web client reported an error of a new kind. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.admin_error_group_reg.defaultMessage: A resolved error happened again on {instance}
notifications.kind.admin_error_group_reg.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications, to an administrator who manages the errors: an error that an administrator marked resolved happened again with a newer version of the server. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.admin_error_group_oth.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications, to an administrator who manages the errors: more new or recurring errors happened in this hour than are notified one by one, and they are counted in one notification. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.admin_hook_failing.defaultMessage: An external review of {instance} keeps failing
notifications.kind.admin_hook_failing.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications, to a moderator: calls of the external review of submissions keep failing. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.admin_domain_list_fai.defaultMessage: A blocklist subscription of {instance} keeps failing
notifications.kind.admin_domain_list_fai.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications, to a moderator: the fetches of a subscribed domain block list keep failing. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.admin_hook_appeal.defaultMessage: A refused post was appealed to the moderators of {instance}
notifications.kind.admin_hook_appeal.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications, to a moderator: a user appealed a post that the server's automated review refused, and the appeal awaits review. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.hook_appeal_decided.defaultMessage: The moderators of {instance} reviewed your appeal of a refused post
notifications.kind.hook_appeal_decided.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications: the moderators upheld or overturned the user's appeal of a post that the automated review refused. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.supporter_service_clo.defaultMessage: Your supporter subscription on {instance} ends with the closure of the server
notifications.kind.supporter_service_clo.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications: the announced closure of the server cancels the user's supporter subscription at the end of its period. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.voice_room_started.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications: an account that the user follows opened a voice chat room that the user may join. {name} is the display name, or the @handle, of the host. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.voice_room_invited.defaultMessage: {name} invited you to a voice chat room
notifications.kind.voice_room_invited.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications: the host or a co-host of a voice chat room invited the user to it. {name} is the display name, or the @handle, of the account that invited the user. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.reply_request.defaultMessage: {name} asked to reply to your post
notifications.kind.reply_request.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications: {name} is the display name, or the @handle, of the account whose reply to the user's post waits for the user's approval. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.boost_request.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications: {name} is the display name, or the @handle, of the account whose boost of the user's post waits for the user's approval. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.quote_request.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications: {name} is the display name, or the @handle, of the account whose quote of the user's post waits for the user's approval. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.interaction_accepted.defaultMessage: {name} approved your interaction with their post
notifications.kind.interaction_accepted.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications: {name} is the display name, or the @handle, of the author of a post who approved the user's reply to it, boost of it, or quote of it. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.interaction_rejected.defaultMessage: {name} declined your interaction with their post
notifications.kind.interaction_rejected.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications: {name} is the display name, or the @handle, of the author of a post who declined the user's reply to it, boost of it, or quote of it. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.event_invited.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications: {name} is the display name, or the @handle, of the account that invited them. {title} is the title of the event, as its organizers wrote it, or the words of push.event_untitled when it has none. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.event_schedule_confir.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications: {title} is the title of the event, as its organizers wrote it, or the words of push.event_untitled when it has none. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.event_changed.defaultMessage: The date or place of {title} changed
notifications.kind.event_changed.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications: {title} is the title of the event, as its organizers wrote it, or the words of push.event_untitled when it has none. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.event_cancelled.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications: {title} is the title of the event, as its organizers wrote it, or the words of push.event_untitled when it has none. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.event_reminder.defaultMessage: {unit, select, day {{count, plural, one {{title} starts in # day} other {{title} starts in # days}}} hour {{count, plural, one {{title} starts in # hour} other {{title} starts in # hours}}} other {{count, plural, one {{title} starts in # minute} other {{title} starts in # minutes}}}}
notifications.kind.event_reminder.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications: {unit} is day, hour, or minute, and {count} how many of them before the start. {title} is the title of the event, as its organizers wrote it, or the words of push.event_untitled when it has none. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.event_started.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications: {title} is the title of the event, as its organizers wrote it, or the words of push.event_untitled when it has none. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.kind.event_room_unavailabl.defaultMessage: The voice chat room of {title} cannot open
notifications.kind.event_room_unavailabl.description: The sentence of a notification in the reader's list of notifications: The event itself stays. {title} is the title of the event, as its organizers wrote it, or the words of push.event_untitled when it has none. Its words are those of the Web Push notification of the same kind.

notifications.requests.defaultMessage: {people, plural, one {Requests from # person} other {Requests from # people}} · {count, plural, one {# notification} other {# notifications}}
notifications.requests.description: The row at the top of the notifications that opens the requests: notifications the reader's notification policy held back, one request per account. people is how many accounts, count how many notifications.
